local.b: Northeast households spent an average of $91,698 in 2025, almost 10% more than in 2024 and nearly $10,000 above the national average, BLS figures show.
local.title: Household spending in Northeast shot up 10% in one year

local.b: BC is retiring the late Johnny Gaudreau's jersey number, and a sculpture of him and brother Matthew is going up in New Jersey.

local.b: Proposals certified as ballot-eligible include cutting the income tax rate from 5% to 4%, ending legislative stipends and ending the gas tax.

local.b: The NITA Ride Safe app lets CTA, Metra and Pace riders report safety concerns by text and photo, with an option to stay anonymous.

local.h: Illinois e-scooter law takes effect Jan. 1
local.b: Devices that can top 28 mph will count as motor vehicles, requiring a driver's license, insurance and registration.

goodnews.b: Teams behind Denver's popular holiday light displays start work in August.

local.h: Did $29M speed up ballot counting?
local.b: The state gave county registrars $29 million to count ballots faster this year, and LA and Orange counties did.
local.title: LA, OC counted ballots faster this year. Will it last?

local.h: CD-9 race tightens as Ugarte gains
local.b: Jose Ugarte gained slightly in the race for South LA's Council District 9, which will come down to a narrow number of ballots.
local.title: Jose Ugarte gains slightly in tight race to represent South LA’s CD-9

local.h: LBUSD finds no problem in Monroe Elementary rooms
local.b: Long Beach Unified says two rounds of environmental testing found nothing concerning in a Monroe Elementary building where dozens of kids got sick.
local.title: LBUSD says it can’t find anything wrong with classrooms where dozens of kids got sick

local.h: Prop 4 defeat is official
local.b: California's ban on public funding for most state and local candidates stays in place after Proposition 4 failed.
local.title: Prop 4 fails, ending latest effort to allow taxpayer funding of California political campaigns

local.h: Audit: schools miss kids' dental checks
local.b: California schools are supposed to make sure young students see a dentist, but many don't, a state audit found.
local.title: California told schools to make sure kids see a dentist. Then the state didn’t follow up

local.h: LAPD still stops Black residents at higher rates
local.b: Efforts to curb racial profiling by the LAPD have fallen short despite a state law meant to address it.

local.h: UC Regents let UCLA police buy more equipment
local.b: The regents authorized UCLA police to buy additional military equipment, including drones.
local.title: UCLA police will add a weapon in their collection that LAPD was banned from using on crowds

local.h: Newsom proposes AI emergency shutdown power
local.b: Gov. Newsom's AI recommendations would let state officials order an immediate emergency shutdown of AI systems they deem dangerous.
local.title: Newsom touts an AI kill switch to halt dangerous OpenAI, Anthropic releases

local.h: Port strike looms Saturday at LA and Long Beach
local.b: A strike is looming Saturday at the ports of Long Beach and Los Angeles, threatening the complex's busiest year on record.

local.b: The plan moves detainees to four borough jails and three hospital units and cuts the jail population to about two-thirds of today's 6,600.
local.title: Mamdani lays out plan to close Rikers by 2032, after years of delays

local.h: HUD takes over Newark Housing Authority
local.b: The federal government took control of New Jersey's largest public housing authority, citing missed occupancy and financial targets.
local.title: Federal government claims control of Newark Housing Authority

local.h: Mamdani closes Bronx shelter targeted by ICE subpoena
local.b: The city closed its last migrant shelter, in Mott Haven, and told a court the ICE subpoena for residents' names is now moot.
local.title: Mamdani shuts Bronx migrant shelter at center of ICE fight over residents’ data

local.h: NY to pay $1.2M in prison sexual assault suit
local.b: The state will pay a woman who accused a former corrections officer of repeated sexual assault at a Manhattan women's prison, her lawyers said.
local.title: NY to pay $1.2M to a woman who accused ex-Manhattan corrections officer of sexual assault

local.h: Duck farm fighting foie gras ban destroyed by fire
local.b: Hudson Valley Foie Gras, which is challenging the city's foie gras ban in court, was destroyed in a fire early Thursday, Sullivan County officials said.
local.title: Hudson Valley duck farm suing over NYC foie gras ban destroyed in fire

local.h: MTA bus video shows Brooklyn building collapse
local.b: A bus camera captured the moment a three-story Flatbush building split and fell on Nov. 11, a collapse that killed eight people.
local.title: Watch: MTA bus video captures moment of deadly Brooklyn building collapse

local.h: Troubled builder picked for NJ ICE warehouse review
local.b: A company run by developer James Grossmann was chosen to lead the court-ordered environmental review of a planned immigration detention facility in Roxbury, NJ.
local.title: Builder facing bankruptcy will lead environmental review of controversial NJ ICE warehouse

local.h: NY delays Medicaid work-rule cutoffs to July
local.b: Gov. Hochul said New Yorkers won't lose Medicaid over new federal work rules until July, and the state will spend $213 million on enrollment help.
local.title: NY to delay enforcement of new Medicaid rules, potentially keeping thousands insured

local.h: Mamdani signs carriage horse ban
local.b: Mayor Zohran Mamdani signed a bill banning the city's horse-drawn carriage industry, which must leave Central Park by June 2028.
local.title: Mayor Mamdani signs NYC's carriage horse ban after decades of animal rights activism

local.h: Family sues city over wrong-way crash death
local.b: The family of a 27-year-old woman killed by a wrong-way driver in the West Village last year filed a wrongful death lawsuit against the city and DOT.
local.title: Family of woman killed in wrong-way crash files wrongful death lawsuit against NYC, DOT

local.h: Bill would ban idling trailers at Hunts Point
local.b: A new City Council bill would ban idling diesel refrigerated trailers at warehouses, targeting Hunts Point Produce Market in the South Bronx.
local.title: Polluting trailers at Hunts Point market would be banned under new NYC Council bill

local.h: Council weighs closing sanctuary-law 'loophole'
local.b: The City Council's immigration committee is considering bills to close a "loophole" in the city's sanctuary laws.
local.title: NYC looks to close a 'loophole' in sanctuary protection for immigrants

local.h: Peanut the squirrel's owner pleads not guilty to fraud
local.b: Mark Longo, 36, was arraigned on mortgage fraud and grand larceny charges and pleaded not guilty.
local.title: Owner of Peanut, scandalously slain NY squirrel, charged with upstate mortgage fraud
